evidence.summary: UWV page "Werk zoeken? Wees online vindbaar" (30 januari 2024): "Ongeveer 70% van de vacatures wordt vervuld door online en fysiek netwerken." Replaces the anecdote ("volgens Pieter"). Re-check yearly.

meaning.situation_summary: A job seeker sees at a desk with laptop and notebook; the card says UWV reports most vacancies are filled through networks, including online.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Know that networking is the main way vacancies are filled.
meaning.contrivance_check: Picture was redrawn as a neutral desk scene so it no longer shows the key; the 70 percent figure is the one stated fact.

items.level_reason: Cause question with two plain reasons; wording simplified from afneemt/populairder to plain A2.

evidence.summary: UWV kansrijke beroepen page: "Dat komt bijvoorbeeld doordat de vraag naar medewerkers afneemt. Of doordat een beroep populairder wordt onder werkzoekenden." Verbatim on the live page.

meaning.situation_summary: A woman walks along a street with small shops; the card explains why a profession leaves the yearly UWV list.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Understand that the list of promising jobs changes with employer demand.
meaning.contrivance_check: The distractor "minder werkzoekenden" is false because the page names more popularity, which makes chances smaller.

items.level_reason: Conditional rule now set up in the prompt, as blueprint 5 requires; options differ only in when.

evidence.quote: alleen nodig als uw werkgever daarom vraagt
evidence.summary: NederlandWereldwijd: "Voldoet uw diploma aan de opleidingseis van de baan in Nederland?" - "Ja: diplomawaardering is alleen nodig als uw werkgever daarom vraagt"; "Een diplomawaardering is een advies aan uw toekomstige werkgever, geen besluit."

meaning.situation_summary: Imane has a foreign diploma that is good enough for the job and asks when she needs an assessment; she sits with a laptop and a rolled certificate.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Learn that the assessment is advice to the employer, needed only on request when the diploma suffices.
meaning.contrivance_check: The old prompt keyed an exception without setting up the condition; the card and prompt now say the diploma is good enough.

items.level_reason: Now tests the purpose of scholing (eindterm 1.1.5) with a persona; distractors are false statements about bijstand.

evidence.quote: om uw kans op werk te vergroten
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid re-integratie page: "Krijgt u een uitkering van de gemeente? Dan zijn u en uw gemeente samen verantwoordelijk voor uw re-integratie" and "De gemeente kan u scholing aanbieden om uw kans op werk te vergroten." Condition and purpose are both on the page.

meaning.situation_summary: Imane receives a gemeente uitkering and is offered training; she sits in a classroom with a notebook and a teacher at a blank board.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Know that scholing from the gemeente is meant to improve chances on the labour market.
meaning.contrivance_check: The source says "kan" so the card does not claim that scholing is always offered; the earlier who-question repeated the gemeente key of other items.

items.level_reason: Persona fact with parallel options; distractors are questions the page says may not be asked.

evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid sollicitatievragen page: "Als horecamedewerker moet u een aantal uren (bijvoorbeeld 4 uur) achter elkaar staand werken." and the employer may ask "of u in staat bent deze taken uit te voeren"; health and private questions are not allowed.

meaning.situation_summary: Orlando applies for a hospitality job and is shown wiping a table; the card says the employer may ask about the job tasks, for example standing for hours.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Learn which question an employer may ask at a job interview.
meaning.contrivance_check: The prompt asks what may be asked, not what to do, so it is not a behaviour question.

items.level_reason: Time fact with three clearly different periods.

evidence.quote: Na twee jaar ziekte kan een werknemer een WIA-uitkering krijgen
evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid regels bij ziekte: "Na 2 jaar ziekte (wachttijd) kan de zieke werknemer in aanmerking komen voor een uitkering. Het gaat dan om een (gedeeltelijke) arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering (WIA-uitkering). UWV bekijkt of hij hier recht op heeft."

meaning.situation_summary: Karin is ill at home on a sofa; the card gives the two-year waiting period and says UWV decides on the WIA.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Know after how long a sick employee can ask for a WIA benefit.
meaning.contrivance_check: Calm picture, no medical detail; the card names UWV so the exchange has a real organisation behind it.

items.level_reason: One stated WW condition; distractors are conditions that do not exist; the keyed option is the shortest.

evidence.summary: Rijksoverheid WW page: "U heeft recht op een WW-uitkering als u: ... direct beschikbaar bent voor betaald werk". The page lists other conditions too (wekeneis); no option states one of them.

meaning.communicative_purpose: Know that a WW benefit requires being directly available for work.
meaning.contrivance_check: The tested condition is the plain one; the other true conditions are not offered as distractors.

items.level_reason: Number fact with three distinct values; confirmed against the live page.

evidence.summary: Live Rijksoverheid page "Hoelang duurt mijn proeftijd?": "De proeftijd kan maximaal 2 maanden duren bij: een vast dienstverband; een tijdelijk arbeidscontract voor 2 jaar of langer." One month applies to shorter temporary contracts.

meaning.situation_summary: Jelle signs a permanent contract and sits at a desk with a sheet and a pen; the card gives the maximum probation period.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Know the maximum probation period for a permanent contract.
meaning.contrivance_check: Older cached copies said one month; the live page says two months, so the key is two.
